# GitHub Copilot Entry Point

Follow the repository [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the closest scoped
`AGENTS.md` for the files being changed. Nested `claude.md` files are optional
topology maps, not behavior source truth. Verify current claims from canonical
documentation, code, tests, policy, and receipts.
